name: Kyeongseong Lubricants
description: Performance engineered lubricants for peak engine performance.
story: Kyeongseong Lubricants has been a leading provider of high-performance lubricants in South Korea for over 30 years. They believe motorsport provides the ultimate testing ground for their products, pushing the boundaries of engine technology. Kyeongseong seeks a partnership that highlights their commitment to innovation and their ability to deliver a competitive edge.
